italian-reading-9.title: QU
italian-reading-9.subtitle: Hear QU in short phrases
italian-reading-9.description: Read common words with QU and recognize the combination in phrases.

ir9-p1.translations: When Luca arrives, he asks, “How much does this book cost?”

ir9-t1.text: In common words, Q comes before U: quando, quanto, questo, qui.

ir9-t2.text: Listen for the combination in words and phrases; this rule does not describe every use of the letter U.

ir9_q1.question: Which common combination appears in the words from this lesson?

ir9_q2.question: Which word contains the QU combination?

ir9_q3.question: Which combination has Q before U?

ir9_q4.question: Which word in the sentence contains QU?

ir9_q5.question: Which word contains QU before the vowel A?
